setup.codeHint: It's in the server's log, printed when Merran started.
setup.householdHint: Like “The Carters”. You can change it later.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How you appear to your household.
profile.emailFixed: Your email can't be changed yet.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing it signs you out on your other devices.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: For connecting other apps, like Home Assistant. A key acts as you in one household, with only the access you give it.
apiKeys.noneHint: Make one to connect another app.
apiKeys.makeDescription: For {{household}}. It stops working if you leave the household.

apiKeys.permissionsHint: Give only what the app needs. Managing the household always needs a sign-in.

apiKeys.revokeDescription: It stops working straight away. Anything using it will need a new key.

myData.title: Your data
myData.description: Your account, the households you're in, the cooking notes you wrote and your API keys' names and permissions (never the keys), as a file to keep. A household's recipes are in its export.

share.title: Share to Merran
share.description: Add a recipe from any app on your phone: share its web page or a link to it, or photos, screenshots or a PDF of it, to Merran. Share a receipt the same way, and it waits on the Pantry page to be looked over.
share.androidSteps: In Chrome, open the menu (⋮) and tap Install app or Add to home screen. Then, in any app, tap Share and pick Merran: a link, a page, photos, screenshots or a PDF.
share.needsHttps: This needs Merran opened at its https address, not a local one like this.
share.iphoneIntro: Apple only lets App Store apps into the share sheet, but a Shortcut can be there instead. It takes a few minutes to set up, once.
share.makeKey: Make a key for the Shortcut

steps.create: Open Shortcuts, tap +, and name it Send to Merran.
steps.shareSheet: Tap ⓘ and turn on Show in Share Sheet.
steps.fetch: Add the action Get Contents of URL, with this address:
steps.method: Tap the arrow beside it, and set Method to POST. Under Headers, add Authorization, with this:
steps.body: Under Request Body, pick Form, add a File field named file, and set it to Shortcut Input.
steps.message: Add Get Dictionary Value, for the key message.

share.after: Now, in Safari or any app, tap Share, then Send to Merran. A notification says what was added.
share.keyNote: The key can only add recipes, to {{household}}, and it's yours: someone else needs their own. It's in your API keys, where it can be removed.

planning.title: Planning
planning.description: The meals Fill the week and Plan each week fill for you: all of them, unless you turn some off. Every meal still shows on the plan, so you can plan one you've turned off yourself whenever you like.

household.noneHint: Ask someone in a household for an invite link.

details.title: Household
details.description: Its name, and how days and weeks work in the plan.
details.adminsOnly: Only the household's admins can change these.
details.name: Name
details.weekStartsOnHint: The first day of the plan's week.

members.title: Members
members.removeDescription: They lose access to this household straight away. They can come back with a new invite link.
members.leaveDescription: You lose access to it straight away. To come back, you'll need a new invite link.

invites.title: Invite links
invites.description: Each link works once, for 7 days.
invites.noneHint: Make a link to invite someone.
invites.makeDescription: Anyone with the link can join, so send it only to the person you're inviting.
invites.roleHint: Admins can change the household's settings and invite people.
invites.madeDescription: Copy it now and send it. It won't be shown again.

new.title: Start another household
new.description: As a server admin, you can start more households. You'll own it and switch to it.

tastes.title: Tastes
tastes.description: What your household eats and doesn't. Fill the week and the autoplan keep to it. Anyone in the household can change it.
tastes.avoidHint: Leave it out: recipes with it are still suggested, with it crossed off and not bought, unless it's what the dish is, like mushroom risotto. Never: recipes with it aren't suggested. Nor are allergies, and nuts, dairy, gluten, eggs and meat get the diet labels' careful check (pesto has nuts, butter is dairy), so they can't just be left out.

themes.title: Theme nights
themes.description: A theme for each night's dinner, like taco night or fish on Friday. Fill the week suggests dinners that fit: tagged or named for it, vegetarian for meatless, never made for something new. Leftovers and eat-out nights stay empty.
themes.tagPlaceholder: A tag, like curry or burgers

autoplan.title: Plan each week
autoplan.description: On the day and hour you pick, the week ahead's empty meals fill themselves from your recipes, the way Fill the week does: keeping to your tastes and theme nights, saying why for each, and never changing a meal that's planned.
autoplan.on: Plan the week ahead for us
autoplan.off: Off. Turn it on to have each week planned before it starts.
autoplan.whenHint: In the household's time zone. It plans the next week to start that day or later.
autoplan.addToList: Put what those meals need on the list
autoplan.noIdeas: No ideas for {{week}}: nothing new in your recipes fits.

nutrition.title: Nutrition for the library
nutrition.descriptionUsda: New recipes get their nutrition by themselves. For ones that came in without it, work it out from USDA's data.
nutrition.descriptionAi: New recipes get their nutrition by themselves. For ones that came in without it, AI can estimate it.
nutrition.allDone: Every recipe with servings has its nutrition.

photos.title: AI photos
photos.description: Photos of the finished dish for recipes without one, all in one style so your library looks like one cookbook. They never replace a real photo.

marble.name: Dark plate, white marble
marble.hint: Matte charcoal dishes on Carrara marble, in soft daylight.

rustic.name: Rustic wood
rustic.hint: Earthenware on a weathered oak table, in warm window light.

bright.name: Bright and airy
bright.hint: White porcelain on pale linen, shot from above.

moody.name: Dark and moody
moody.hint: Slate dishes on black stone, with one dramatic light.

photos.noKey: Making photos needs an OpenAI or Google key: add one under AI above.

stores.title: Stores
stores.description: Your Kroger store, Fry's, Ralphs or another of Kroger's, to see its prices and send the list to its cart. Other stores' links are on the list already.
stores.storeHint: Find your store by its ZIP code.
stores.noneNear: No Kroger stores near that ZIP code.
stores.modalityHint: Prices and what's in stock can differ between them.
stores.accountHint: Link a {{store}} account to send the list to its cart. Everyone here sends to that one cart.
stores.linkedBy: Linked by {{by}} {{when}}. The list goes to this account's cart.
stores.linked: Linked {{when}}. The list goes to this account's cart.
stores.relinkTitle: Kroger stopped taking the linked account
stores.relinkHint: It may have had its password changed, or the link ran out. Link it again to send the list.
stores.leanHint: How much Fill the week and the weekly autoplan pick recipes with real deals. Prices are checked each morning.
stores.checked: Prices checked {{when}}, and each morning. Only real deals count, not sales barely off the usual price.
stores.checkedNow_one: Prices checked: {{count}} deal in your recipes.
stores.checkedNow_other: Prices checked: {{count}} deals in your recipes.
stores.budgetHint: What you mean to spend on food in a week. Fill the week and the autoplan pick recipes that fit what's left of it more often. Leave it empty for none.

about.title: This server
about.noAddress: Not set, so links use the address in the browser

errorTracking.title: Error tracking
errorTracking.description: Send errors from the server and from browsers to your own Sentry, GlitchTip or Bugsink. Reports leave out cookies, keys and who was signed in.
errorTracking.dsnHint: From your error tracker's project settings. Leave it empty to keep errors in the server's log only.
errorTracking.environmentHint: To tell this server's errors apart from others'.
errorTracking.saved: Saved. Browsers pick it up when they next open Merran.

telemetry.title: Telemetry
telemetry.description: An anonymous summary once a day helps the Merran project see how many servers run it, on which versions, and which parts get used.
telemetry.send: Send an anonymous summary once a day
telemetry.never: Never names, recipes, keys, or anything anyone typed.
telemetry.installIdHint: The install id is random. A new one means later summaries can't be linked to earlier ones.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: Work Merran does in the background: imports, emptying Recently deleted, the daily summary. Finished jobs stay here for 30 days.

kinds.purgeDeleted: Emptying old recipes from Recently deleted

video.title: Video import
video.description: Recipes from TikTok, YouTube, Instagram and Facebook links. yt-dlp reads the caption, captions and pictures, and AI writes the recipe up.
video.install: Both come with the Docker image. Elsewhere, install them, or put them in the data folder's tools folder.
video.cookies: A cookies.txt is set, for sites that want a signed-in session.
video.noCookies: No cookies.txt. Instagram and some YouTube videos may want one: put one from your browser in the data folder.
video.enabledHint: Paste or share a video link like any other.
video.autoUpdateHint: Weekly. It stops working when sites change, and is fixed within days.

nutrition.title: Nutrition
nutrition.description: A key for USDA FoodData Central works recipes' nutrition out from their ingredients. It's free: <link>get one at api.data.gov</link>. Without one, households with AI get an estimate.
nutrition.keyHint: Paste the key api.data.gov sends you. It's tested before it's saved.
nutrition.keySet: A key is saved. Paste another to replace it.

sites.title: Recipe sites
sites.description: Merran reads recipe sites' feeds every few hours, as Merran and following robots.txt: the suggested sites, for starter collections, and any a household follows.
sites.notRead: Not read yet: the first read starts a minute after Merran does.
sites.enabledHint: Off, households can't follow sites, and collections keep only what's been read already.

photos.title: AI photos
photos.description: A photo of the finished dish for recipes without one, on a household's OpenAI or Google key: about 1.5¢ a photo with OpenAI, 4¢ with Google. Each household picks how they look. They never replace a real photo.
photos.enabledHint: Households with an OpenAI or Google key can make them, and make them for their whole library.
photos.autoHint: One made by itself for a recipe added without a photo: typed in, read from text, or from the assistant. Never for a library moved in at once.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Who reads cook steps aloud when cooking hands-free. Each step is read once and kept, and if the server's voice fails, the device's reads instead.

hints.device: Each phone, tablet or computer reads in the best voice it has. Nothing leaves the server.
hints.kokoro: Kokoro runs beside Merran, free, and sounds close to a person: the same on every device.
hints.openai: OpenAI's voices, about 1.5¢ a minute of reading, on a household's OpenAI key. Without one, its devices read in their own.

voice.kokoroUrlHint: Where Kokoro answers, like http://kokoro:8880 from the compose file. It may be on your home network.
voice.openaiHint: Hearing a voice costs a fraction of a cent the first time, on your household's OpenAI key.

kroger.title: Kroger
kroger.description: A Kroger developer app lets households pick their Kroger store (Fry's, Ralphs, King Soopers, Fred Meyer and the rest), see its prices and send the list to its cart. It's free: <link>make one at developer.kroger.com</link> with the Product, Cart and Profile APIs, and give it the redirect address below.
kroger.redirectHint: Add this to the Kroger app as its redirect URI.
kroger.redirectHere: Add this to the Kroger app as its redirect URI. It's the address you're using now: set the server's public address so it doesn't change.
kroger.secretHint: Both are tested with Kroger before they're saved.
kroger.secretSet: A secret is saved. Paste another to replace it.
kroger.works: It works: Kroger took the app.

export.title: Export this household
export.description: A zip of its recipes, with their photos, versions, cooking notes and pairings, to keep or to move to another Merran. Recipes in Recently deleted, AI keys and other secrets stay behind.

install.title: Put Merran on your home screen
install.hint: It opens like an app: full screen, from its own icon.
install.installed: Merran's installed here: it opens from your home screen, or like an app on a computer.

guide.title: Install Merran

ios.share: Tap Share: the square with an arrow, at the bottom of Safari or the top of Chrome.
ios.add: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen.
ios.done: Tap Add. Merran's on your home screen, and opens like an app.

guide.mac: In Safari's menu bar, choose File, then Add to Dock.

menu.choose: Choose Install Merran or Add to Home screen.
menu.none: No such choice? This browser can't install web apps. Chrome, Edge and Safari can.

guide.insecure: Merran's open over http here, not https, so browsers only add a shortcut rather than an app. Whoever runs Merran can set up https.
